name: The Wedding of River Song
oracle_text:
Draw two cards, then you may exile a nonland card from your hand with a number of time counters on it equal to its mana value. Then target opponent does the same. Cards exiled this way that don't have suspend gain suspend.
Time travel. (For each suspended card you own and each permanent you control with a time counter on it, you may add or remove a time counter.)
blocked_sentences: Time travel. (For each suspended card you own and each permanent you control with a time counter on it, you may add or remove a time counter.)

needs.what: the keyword action time travel (701.55): for each suspended card the controller owns in exile and each permanent they control with a time counter on it, the controller may add one time counter, remove one time counter, or leave it, chosen per object
needs.why_existing_wont_do: No op or selector names a suspended card: the selector keys have has_counters and zone but nothing that reads the engine's suspended mark (suspend.suspended_cards), so a for_each over exile cards with time counters would also catch non-suspended exiled cards with time counters; proliferate only adds and covers every counter kind and every player; add_counters/remove_counters act on a fixed set with no per-object add-or-remove choice. The first sentence is expressible with the suspend op inside for_each_player/for_each (amount mana_value_of the chosen card), but the card cannot be written partially
